annotations.title: Professional Liability — Ransomware / Extortion Exclusion
annotations.content:
[Ugly] Professional Liability — Ransomware / Extortion Exclusion
Risk Score: 16/25

What this means:
Ransomware is the #1 cyber threat to election infrastructure right now. Your professional liability policy excludes it entirely. Your cyber policy covers it up to $4 million — but that same $4 million also has to cover business interruption, data restoration, breach notification, lawsuits, and regul

Recommendation:
Increase Cyber aggregate to $10M minimum, with separate ransomware sublimit at $5M+. Implement and document offline backups, segmented networks, and incident response retainer for underwriter credit.
